summary: Nuveen Churchill Private Capital Income Fund (the Fund) filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events disclosing its monthly NAV per share as of May 31, 2026, regular distribution declarations, and portfolio update. No M&A or special situation event occurred—the filing is a routine periodic NAV and subscription/repurchase disclosure for a closed-end fund. The Fund reported aggregate NAV of ~$1.5B, with subscription proceeds of $71.3M in Q2 2026 and an estimated 2.3% of shares tendered in its repurchase offer. This is standard interval fund reporting, not a strategic or structural corporate event.
